artworks.title: Louis XVI, King of France
artworks.artist: Antoine Louis Romanet after Joseph Siffred Duplessis
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [trial state]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 39.2 x 29.8 cm (15 7/16 x 11 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is at a slight angle, facing left with a confident expression. His 18th-century style hair is powdered and parted on the side, with curls framing his face. He wears elaborate attire, including a high-collared coat, an ornate sash with a star, and a medallion on a necklace. The portrait is framed with a detailed border, and the background is dark.

artworks.title: Charles-Georges Coqueley de Chaussepierre
artworks.artist: Jean Francois Rousseau after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 10 x 9.2 cm (3 15/16 x 3 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a close-up portrait of a man's head and shoulders shown in profile view facing left. The man has an aquiline nose, a prominent chin, and detailed curled hair styled in tight rolls cascading towards his shoulders. He wears a coat and an undergarment with a high collar typical of the 18th century. The image is circular, framed with decorative text around the perimeter. The background has lined textures within the circular frame. At the bottom, there are inscriptions with the artist's name and the year 1780.

artworks.title: Comte de Buffon
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Piat Joseph Sauvage
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile within an ornate circular frame. The man has a pronounced nose and detailed shading on his facial features. His hair is styled in a classic manner and tied back with a ribbon. He is dressed in formal attire from the 18th-century, complete with a high collar or cravat. Below the portrait, there is a trumpet, foliage resembling a laurel branch, and a partially unrolled scroll with text. The background features a textured dark surface with a patterned frame and decorative leafy motif above the circular frame against an engraved sky with light clouds.

artworks.title: Joseph Pellerin
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of an older man in profile facing to the right. He has a prominent nose and a strong jawline, with tightly curled white hair. The man is dressed in a formal coat with large buttons and a garment featuring a ruffled collar. There are no visible objects in his hands. Around him is an ornate circular frame with a bow at the top and an inscription "Joannis Pellerin, Anno 1788, Aetatis 84" indicating his name and age. Below the frame are the words "Animo Maturus et Avvo." The background is textured with fine lines, creating depth and a formal atmosphere.

artworks.title: Antoine De Parcieux
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Charles-Nicolas Cochin I
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.1 x 12.8 cm (7 1/8 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's bust in profile, featuring his facial features, hairstyle, and attire. He has a prominent nose, slightly pronounced chin, and his eyes looking straight ahead. His hair is styled in tight curls framing his head and falling to the nape of his neck. The man wears a coat with a high collar and visible buttons. The background has a textured pattern with a circular border and a decorative bow on top. Below the image is the name "ANTOINE DE PARCELUX" and additional text related to his life and achievements.

artworks.title: Charles Le Brun
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.6 x 14.7 cm (8 1/2 x 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man in profile facing to the left. He has strong, defined features with a prominent nose and chin, with long, voluminous curls framing his head. He wears a high-collared historical garment with a bow and an ornate pendant or medal on his chest. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with a textured rectangular border. Below the portrait is the inscription "CH. LE BRUN." The background has horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Pierre Corneille
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in profile, with facial features such as a long nose and a prominent chin. He has medium-length wavy hair and is dressed in period clothing. The man is framed in an oval frame, with a label below reading "P. CORNEILLE." The artist's name "Aug. St. Aubin fecit" is inscribed beneath the frame.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Rousseau
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a bust portrait engraving of a man identified as J.B. Rousseau, showing his upper torso and head. He is positioned in profile, facing left. His facial features include a prominent nose and a slight double chin. His hair is styled in elaborate curls. He is wearing a high-collared shirt with a cravat and a coat, both depicted in detailed engraving strokes. The portrait is encased within an oval frame, with no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background features a lined pattern, and there is an inscription with his name, "J.B. ROUSSEAU," along with the engraver's mark at the bottom, "Aug. St. Aubin fecit."

artworks.title: Prosper Jolyot de Crebillon
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.1 x 12 cm (7 15/16 x 4 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man in profile, with short, white hair and aged features. He is wearing a loose garment and a dark robe. The background is an oval frame with intricate detailing, and there is an engraved nameplate reading "CRÉBILLON" under the portrait.

artworks.title: Charles Henri de Heineken
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.5 x 15 cm (8 1/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in profile facing right. He has distinguished facial features and appears older. The man wears a textured hat covering most of his head, with curly hair visible around the edges. He wears a garment with a fur collar. The portrait is in a circular frame with a ribbon at the top. Below the portrait is a textual inscription with the man's name, Charles Henri de Heineken, and additional descriptive titles. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Gerard de Lairesse
artworks.artist: Pieter Schenck I after Gerard de Lairesse
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man. He is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer in a three-quarter profile view. He has curly hair falling to his shoulders and strong facial features with a prominent gaze. The man is dressed elaborately, wearing a voluminous coat with wide sleeves and ornate lace cuffs. A luxurious draped fabric surrounds him. In the background to the left, there is a classical bust on a pedestal. The image is framed with dark tones and engraved text, including an inscription that reads "GERARDUS LARESSE PICTOR LEODIENSIS."

artworks.title: Jacques Delille
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 31.7 x 22.6 cm (12 1/2 x 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in formal attire from the 18th century. He has a calm expression, distinct facial structure, and wears a powdered wig. The portrait is framed by decorative elements including leaves, fruit, and a musical horn. Below the portrait is an engraving of classical figures in a pastoral scene, with books and a basket of produce to the sides. The background features engravings of foliage and a beehive-like structure, suggesting a classical and scholarly theme.

artworks.title: The Temple of Antoninus and Faustina
artworks.medium: black chalk on paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of an ornate building seen from a slightly elevated perspective. A central colonnade with tall columns and detailed capitals is the focal point. The horizon line is low, and there are no elements on it. The drawing style features loose pencil strokes emphasizing structure and perspective. The color palette is monochromatic with pencil grays on warm paper. The building extends with intricate details in the distance, while the ground has subtle lines suggesting paving.

artworks.title: Head of a Siren
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketched portrait of a person. The figure is turned slightly to the viewer's right, showcasing a three-quarter view of the face. The portrait features delicate facial features, smooth complexion, full lips, and bright eyes looking to the right. The person has long, wavy hair cascading around their shoulders. The clothing is loosely sketched, suggesting soft fabric. The background is plain with a subtle texture. An inscription in the upper left corner reads "1609."

artworks.title: Reclining Nude
artworks.medium: lithograph on cardboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketched art piece of a human figure reclining on a surface in a fetal-like position. The figure is lying on their side with one arm under their head and the other arm across their torso. The facial features are soft and slightly abstract, and the hair is drawn with wavy lines blending into the background pattern. The individual in the image is not wearing clothing. The surface beneath them has bold, wavy lines resembling fabric or bedding. The background is a high-contrast abstract design with dark, irregular patterns surrounding the figure.

artworks.title: Dancing Couple (Tanzpaar)
artworks.medium: lithograph on yellow wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows flowing black lines and shapes against a vibrant yellow background. The lines and forms suggest human figures entwined or interacting, with one prominent figure having a discernible face. The curves and contours resemble intertwined limbs and abstract shapes that may represent draped fabrics or organic forms. The elements in the visual evoke movement and fluidity, akin to a dynamic dance captured in an abstract style.

artworks.title: Naked Girls in the Studio (Nackte Mädchen im Atelier)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This print depicts two nude women. One woman in the center of the print is standing, her body facing us, her head turned to the left. One of her knees is slightly bent, and her hands are together, holding a cloth. She has dark, thick hair styled up into a bun, and simple facial features created with angular lines: thin eyebrows, a straight nose, and a round, closed mouth. The other woman is seated on the left of the print, facing left, leaning forward and raising a cigarette to her mouth with one hand. Her dark hair is styled up around her head, and she appears to be wearing an earring. The background is minimalistic, with abstract shapes and lines, including a bucket-shaped object between the women. The print uses bold, black lines on a light, off-white background.

artworks.title: Russian Dancers
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals. On the left, there is a person sitting, with their body shown from the upper thighs to the head. This person has their hair swept back away from the face, and is draped in a white garment. The facial features are simple. To the right, there is another person standing and facing the seated individual, shown from the upper body to the lower legs. This standing figure has short, dark hair and is wearing a bright yellow shirt with long sleeves and light blue pants. They appear to be holding a white cloth near the seated person's head. The background is composed of abstract patterns using colors like dark blue, red, and white. The overall style is loose and painterly, with bold use of color and simplified forms.

artworks.title: Three Bathers by Stones
artworks.medium: color lithograph in pink, blue, red, and black on calendered paper
artworks.description: This painting features abstract figures against a blue background. Three figures in bold pink lines are depicted near a blue area. The contrast between the figures and the blue background creates a dynamic composition. The use of color and brushstrokes conveys motion and spontaneity. The forms are simplified, emphasizing abstraction.

artworks.title: Saint John at the Foot of the Cross
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Baer
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length sketch of a person standing and facing slightly to the side. The person is depicted in a three-quarter view from the back, directing their gaze upward to the left. They have short, wavy hair that is neatly combed back. The clothing consists of flowing, draped garments, typical of classical attire, with visible folds and lines adding depth to the fabric's texture. There is no visible jewelry or object being held by the person. The background consists of an empty space, and the entire image is bordered by a series of rectangular frames that accentuate the central sketch. The frames vary in thickness and are layered to give the appearance of depth.

artworks.title: Road along a Winding River
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, squared in black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Baer
artworks.description: The image is a landscape sketch depicting a view from an elevated point. The horizon is positioned at the vertical center, with undulating lines suggesting distant hills or tree lines. There is a horizontal axis across the center, adding depth to the landscape. The sketch features expressive brushstrokes, swirling lines representing foliage and water movement. The color palette is monotone, using sepia tones for an antique look. The foreground has curved lines indicating flowing water or terrain, while detailed strokes suggest vegetation and rocky outcrops in the distance. The grid overlay serves as a structured backdrop, indicating the drawing may be a study.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.medium: engraving in brown ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to and within plate mark): 29.9 x 44.2 cm (11 3/4 x 17 3/8 in.)

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ, Set in a Mountainous Landscape
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 32.2 x 45.5 cm (12 11/16 x 17 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from above, featuring distant hills, a cloudy sky, and a castle-like structure surrounded by trees. There is a river scene with figures near the foreground, one holding a staff. The artwork is monochromatic with various shades of gray, resembling an engraving. Tall trees near the river add depth to the composition, leading the eye towards the central structure and distant mountains.

artworks.title: Juno
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.5 x 16.7 cm (8 7/16 x 6 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated from the side, leaning on her left elbow on a ledge. Her right hand is on top of her left arm. Her head is slightly tilted to the left with a gentle expression, soft facial features, and wavy hair styled back with a headdress. She wears a gown with puffed sleeves and draping. In the background, there is a sculpted surface with a garland on the left and a peacock behind her on the right. The peacock's plume adds detail to the composition. The overall tone of the image is earthy and warm.
